title: Seventh Station: Jesus Falls the Second Time
text:
Consider the second fall of Jesus under the Cross - a fall which renews the pain of all the wounds of the head and members of our afflicted Lord.

My most gentle Jesus, how many times Thou hast pardoned me,
and how many times I have fallen again, and begun again to
offend Thee! Oh, by the merits of this new fall, give me the necessary grace to persevere until death. Grant that in all temptations which gather against me that I may always commend myself to Thee. I love Thee my Jesus; I love Thee more than myself; I am sorry for having offended Thee. Never let me stray from Thee again. Grant that I may always love Thee and do Thy will. Amen.
notes: Text as distributed in the 'Catholic Prayers' Android app (richarddean.angeles.catholicprayers).
